Hi Monica,

We’re prepping for a routine SOC 2 control assessment next week and our security team has asked for two things from Redwood: 1) your current Incident Response Procedures (high-level document is fine) and 2) a short, redacted summary of the Feb 15th incident (timeline + mitigations + any artifacts you can share).

Can you point me to the right person to provide these and share a secure artifact bundle (or Drive folder) we can download? Our assessor needs the material by EOD next Tuesday (2026-03-24).

- List of IOC / indicators that were used
- Logs/audit slices supporting the timeline (limited to the affected subsystems)
- Attestation that customer data access was not impacted

If you have a link (or a short PDF) please send it over. Happy to jump on a quick call if that's faster.

Thanks,
Daniel Park

Hi Daniel — sending over the sanitized materials and a short inline summary below. Full attachments are in the Drive folder (shared link at the bottom). Password-protected zip of audit slices will be delivered separately.

Sanitized incident summary (Feb 15, 2026) — brief:
- Detection: 2026-02-15 02:14 UTC — anomalous outbound traffic from a worker pool was flagged by our runtime telemetry.
- Triage: 02:18–02:40 UTC — our on-call runbook executed automatic isolation for the affected instances; no customer auth tokens were exported.
- Containment: 02:40 UTC — the compromised process was terminated, networking rules tightened, and an emergency patch deployed to 3 hosts.
- Recovery: 02:55–04:30 UTC — services were gradually restored behind additional monitoring and traffic shaping; full verification finished by 06:10 UTC.
- Impact: No customer data access detected (internal review + sampling of object-store reads). We retained a forensic snapshot for our security team and a redacted log slice for customer review.
- Actions taken: updated FW rules, added an extra telemetry assertion for outbound connection counts, and scheduled an architecture review for April.

Attachments included in the Drive bundle: IRP_v2.1.pdf (redacted), incident_log_20260215.csv (sanitized indicators only), sanitized_postmortem.txt (one-page memo). We cannot share raw forensic images; those are retained in our secure evidence vault.

Drive link (read-only; expires 2026-04-20): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_shared_irp
Password for audit slices: will be provided via separate e2ee channel.

If your assessor needs an attestation letter signed by our Security Head, we can provide that on company letterhead — let us know the recipient and delivery method.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
